steps.prompt_exact: I need a small browser board I can save and open on my phone as one HTML file: I enter a topic and audience, it helps me draft several search-result promises, score each for specificity, proof, and risk, edit the cards, and copy a concise brief.
steps.response_summary: ChatGPT returned a self-contained Search Promise Board HTML file with topic/audience inputs, generated editable promise cards, sliders for specificity/proof/risk, brief copy, and text export.

steps.notes: Static scan found dynamic innerHTML use in the card renderer. The strings were escaped, but recent PathForge gates reject this pattern for user-entered text, so v1 was preserved and repaired instead of uploaded as final.

steps.prompt_exact: This is close, but the editable card renderer uses innerHTML for user-entered content, which makes it too easy to fail safety review. Please rewrite the same one-file board so cards are built with DOM text/value assignments instead, while keeping the mobile layout and copy/export workflow.
steps.response_summary: ChatGPT rebuilt the board so card rendering uses createElement, textContent, value, and replaceChildren instead of innerHTML while keeping the mobile layout and copy/export workflow.
